name: Mount Vigil
description: A mountain with a long shadow, where the dark is made to explain itself.

foot.name: The Foot of the Mountain
foot.description: A bare shelf of rock at the bottom of a very long climb. The path starts here and does not look back. South, the village; north, a stair cut into the mountain by people who wanted you to feel every step of it.

stair.name: The Pilgrim Stair
stair.description: Stone steps worn into dishes by feet nobody remembers. Every hundred steps there is a cairn, and on every cairn someone has left a candle, and every candle has burned down to a nub.

cairns.name: The Field of Cairns
cairns.description: A tilted meadow of grey stones, each marked with a name scratched so shallowly the rain has half taken it. Something pale moves between them, unhurried.

gate.name: The Crypt Gate
gate.description: A low black gate in the mountain's flank, standing open. From it comes a smell of old wax and a light that does not flicker, however much the wind does.

north.failure_message: You stop at the gate. The candles inside, all together, lean toward you.

hall.name: The Hall of Candles
hall.description: A long vaulted hall lined with niches, each holding a candle that has burned for longer than the hall has had a roof. The air is cold and the floor is dry as bone.

mirror_stair.name: The Mirror Stair
mirror_stair.description: A last short stair, the walls polished black as glass, so that you climb it between two of yourself. At the top the stair ends in a plain archway, and beyond it, daylight.

summit.name: The Still Summit
summit.description: A flat disc of white stone at the very top of the mountain, with no wind. The sky is enormous and perfectly clear. In the middle of the stone, someone is waiting.

bridge.name: The Narrow Bridge
bridge.description: A bridge of one slab of black stone, no wider than your shoulders, across a drop that has no bottom. A great many names are scratched into the parapet by people who did not come back. The far end is a long way off.

bridge_end.name: The Far End of the Bridge
bridge_end.description: The slab broadens into a landing at the foot of a short stair of polished black glass. Behind you the bridge is a thread across nothing. Ahead, the daylight.

north.failure_message: The way up is shut by the thing that follows you.
